name: Missing Music
author: MVBar
description: Use Deezer to find missing albums and songs, import curated playlists with artwork, detect incomplete local albums, manage requests, and safely stage exact Deezer items.

providerBaseUrl.title: Request provider URL (optional)
providerBaseUrl.description: Leave blank to use a managed wanted list. Set this only when an external service accepts and tracks requests for you.

providerApiToken.title: Request provider API token
providerApiToken.description: Optional bearer token sent only to the configured request-provider origin.

allowPrivateProvider.title: Allow a private-network provider
allowPrivateProvider.description: Explicitly permit an HTTP(S) provider on localhost or a private IP range.

requireAdminApproval.title: Require administrator approval
requireAdminApproval.description: Keep new user requests pending until an administrator approves them.

autoDownloadDeezer.title: Auto-download from Deezer
autoDownloadDeezer.description: When administrator approval is off and no external request provider is configured, automatically stage exact Deezer albums, tracks, and playlist-import items.

preferSpecialEditions.title: Prefer special editions
preferSpecialEditions.description: When Deezer lists several editions with the same base album title, prefer Deluxe, Expanded, Extended, or similar editions instead of the standard edition.

musicBrainzContact.title: Legacy MusicBrainz contact
musicBrainzContact.description: Optional contact email or URL used only by legacy MusicBrainz compatibility paths. Deezer is the primary catalog and does not require this setting.

releaseGroupTypes.title: Release types
releaseGroupTypes.description: Comma-separated Deezer record types to compare, for example Album,EP,Single.

excludedSecondaryTypes.title: Exclude release variants
excludedSecondaryTypes.description: Comma-separated Deezer-derived release variants to hide. Supported values currently include Compilation, Live, Remix, and Soundtrack.

config.reason: Read Missing Music settings for Deezer staging, approval, release filtering, and the optional external request provider.

kvstore.reason: Store saved Deezer artist mappings and compatibility cache entries.

catalog.reason: Read metadata from enabled MVBar music libraries to determine which Deezer albums and tracks are already present.

requests.reason: Create and manage Missing Music request records, including hidden batch items used by Deezer playlist imports.

playlists.reason: Create and populate user-owned MVBar playlists from imported Deezer playlists.

staging.reason: Download and stage Deezer media in the server-configured Missing Music staging library.

libraryAccess.reason: Grant the requesting user access to the Missing Music staging library so imported tracks can appear in their library and playlists.
